## Context / Problem

Scheduled `Live External Integration` run 43815882263 (2026-11-15 22:18 PST, head b4e0d01b649) failed only on `external LLM (live bedrock)`, with 3 tests:
`test_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py::test_live_veto_spares_findings_that_report_a_wrong_plan_citation[agentic]` and `[single_turn]` ("only 0/3 runs kept every finding that reports a wrong plan citation"), and `test_review_kernel_rules_live.py::test_live_verifier_obeys_independence_and_allows_insufficient` ("only 0/3 runs declined to affirm the false claim"). The messages read as a model-behavior regression after the 5.5 model move. They are not.

### Root cause, measured

- Every one of the 9 plan-reviewer calls those tests made got `503 ServiceUnavailableException` ("Bedrock is unable to process your request") from `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`. The account's Bedrock invocation log (`/bedrock/invocation-logs`, us-east-1) records 45 such errors for role `rebar-external-ci-bedrock` between 06:19:09 and 06:27:31 UTC (5 attempts per call) and zero successful responses for those requests. Other opus-5-5 calls from the same job between and after the failures succeeded. The same error burst hit the production instance role on 2026-11-13 (30 errors, 17:00 UTC hour). This is a Bedrock-side fault.
- The model behaves correctly: the same 3 tests on the same commit against the same account, region and model pass 3/3 locally (2026-11-16), and all 29 plan-reviewer calls passed in each of the 4 earlier dispatch runs on the 5.5 models.
- The rebar defect: the runner raises `LLMUnavailableError`, `verify_findings` degrades the chunk to no verification, and these tests count a degraded run as a behavioral failure. A provider outage is therefore reported as "the verifier affirmed the false claim" / "the veto dropped the finding". `tests/external/test_code_review_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py` has the same pattern. Reproduced deterministically by injecting the observed 503 into every botocore `Converse` call: all 4 tests fail with the behavioral messages above.

## Approach

In each of the 3 test modules, the `run_chunk` seam catches `rebar.llm.errors.LLMError` from `runner.run`, appends `"<ExceptionType>: <message>"` (truncated to 300 chars) to a per-test `provider_errors` list, and re-raises, so `verify_findings` behaves exactly as before. Each run in which the seam recorded an error and no verification came back counts as an unavailable run. Before the behavioral assertions, each test asserts `unavailable_runs <= _RUNS - majority` with a message naming the mode, the count, and the first provider error, stating that verifier behavior was not measured. The test still FAILS on an outage (the workflow's policy is to fail loudly, never skip), but now says why. Thresholds and behavioral assertions are unchanged. No new config keys, env vars, fixtures, or shared helpers: the logic is inlined per module.

Why this fits: the misreport is what turned a provider outage into a model-regression hypothesis; the provider fault itself is outside rebar and production already fails over to direct Anthropic for it (`rebar.toml` `[llm.model_classes]` fallback), while the CI Bedrock arm deliberately has no fallback so it measures Bedrock alone.

## Scope

- `tests/external/test_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py`
- `tests/external/test_review_kernel_rules_live.py`
- `tests/external/test_code_review_cited_reference_veto_scope_live.py`

## Testing

- Failure path (written first, run on the unfixed tree): with a `sitecustomize.py` on `PYTHONPATH` that makes every botocore `Converse` call raise `ClientError` code `ServiceUnavailableException` / HTTP 503, run the 4 tests on the Bedrock overlay. Unfixed: they fail with the behavioral messages (observed). Fixed: each fails with the provider-unavailable message containing `ServiceUnavailableException`.
- Happy path: the same 4 tests against real Bedrock (`REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml`, us-east-1) pass.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] With injected 503s on every Bedrock `Converse` call, all 4 tests fail and each failure message names `ServiceUnavailableException` and says verifier behavior was not measured; verified by running them with the fault-injection `sitecustomize.py` after observing the old behavioral messages on the unfixed tree.
- [x] Against real Bedrock (us-east-1, Bedrock overlay) the 4 tests pass; verified by a local pytest run.
- [x] `make lint` with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on `PATH` exits 0.
- [x] [non-codebase] The change lands through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; change number, votes and merged SHA on origin/main are recorded as a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit rebar.solutions.navateam.com change 3404 and GitHub navapbc/rebar origin/main; principal=RebarBotNava (Gerrit REST /a/ via git credential helper) and gh CLI; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — GET /a/changes/3404/detail?o=DETAILED_LABELS returned status MERGED 2026-11-16 15:30:10 PST, LLM-Review +1 (rebar-review-bot), Verified +1 (rebar-ci-bot), current revision 5909040828603167b39fab1595cb28f000137986, which `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` shows as origin/main's head; recorded in the ticket comment of 2026-11-16.
